Team,

The EEOC has extended the EEO-1 report filing deadline from March 31 to April 15, 2026. Please use the new deadline when creating the compliance task. The spreadsheet still shows the old date.

- Compliance Officer"}

主题：Compliance Task Assignment Policy
Team,

Per HR policy, compliance tasks must be assigned to the TEAM, not to individual people. Individual assignment of compliance tasks requires Director-level sign-off. Create tasks with the team name as the assignee. Do not assign to specific individuals.

- HR Director"}
